instructions: Rinse the rice, then put it in a saucepan with 2 cups of water. Bring it to a boil over high heat, cover, turn the heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, off the heat, whisk 2/3 cup of the soy sauce, the mirin, rice vinegar and brown sugar in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves. Grate in the ginger and the garlic.
Cut the eggplants into 3/4-inch chunks and add them to the bowl. Toss to coat and let them sit for 10 minutes, stirring a couple of times.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Lift half the eggplant out of the bowl with a slotted spoon, leaving the liquid behind.
Add that eggplant to the skillet and cook for 6 minutes, stirring now and then, until it's browned in spots and soft. Transfer it to a plate.
Heat the other tbsp of oil, then cook the second half of the eggplant the same way. Transfer it to the plate.
Stir the cornstarch into 2 tbsp of cold water. Pour the liquid left in the bowl into the skillet and simmer over medium heat for 1 minute.
Stir in the cornstarch mixture and simmer for 1 minute, until the sauce is glossy and thick enough to coat a spoon.
Return the eggplant to the skillet and toss for 1 minute to coat. Slice the green onions.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a splash of the rest of the soy sauce.
Spoon the eggplant and sauce over the rice and top with the green onions and sesame seeds.
method_notes: No version of this dish has 20 ratings, so the lead is the unrated Cupful of Kale version (52 comments): eggplant chunks marinated in soy, mirin, rice vinegar, brown sugar, ginger and garlic, then cooked in a hot pan and served over short-grain rice. A cornstarch glaze from the Eat Drink Shrink version thickens the leftover marinade so it soaks into the rice, and the rice is a real amount so the timeline holds. The ratings seen were 5.0 from 1 and 5.0 from 7 for other versions. Sriracha in two sources is left out to keep the base mild. Honest total is about 35 minutes, a little over the 30 minute target.
